sample_unit: LLM responses (47 simulated HS cases x 5 LLMs; 705 dermatologist evaluations)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to HS patient consultations versus recommended patient education level
links.effect: Readability was more demanding than recommended for patient education materials; numeric readability scores not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Readability was more demanding than recommended for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluates zero-shot LLM responses across simulated complex Hidradenitis suppurativa patient consultations on empathy, readability, accuracy, and exposome awareness without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
